selected_branches.branch: Parking upon the approach to a roadside official signal.

law_text: A person shall not stop, stand or park a vehicle, except when necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic or in compliance with law or the directions of a police officer or official traffic-control device, in any of the following places: Within 30 feet upon the approach to any official traffic-control signal located at the side of a highway.
